AS 23.30.118 (SB 147 / Ch. 12 SLA 2024, effective January 1, 2025). PTSD must be diagnosed by a licensed psychologist or psychiatrist during employment or within 3 years after the last date of employment. The presumption is rebuttable by a preponderance of evidence that the PTSD resulted from non-work factors. No minimum service requirement applies.
